passages.note: Operative text repeals Indiana's license/permit requirement to carry a handgun (annex: meets rung 5 for a state officeholder), but Pierce voted Nay on this bill, so it shows opposition to the repeal only.
Pierce is listed among the 30 Nay votes on the Conference Committee Report adopting HB 1296, the bill repealing the handgun carry license requirement.
passages.actor_quote: Campbell Hatcher Pierce DeLaney Hatfield Porter

rows.reasoning: Pierce was recorded among the 30 Nay votes on the conference committee report adopting HB 1296 (2022), whose operative section provides that a qualifying adult 'is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana' — content the annex ties to 'Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit' for a state officeholder. His No vote shows only that he opposed repealing the carry license, not which of the more-restrictive rungs he holds.
